title: Argentinian Empanadas with Crispy Beans
description: A fusion of traditional Argentinian empanadas filled with crispy zesty beans, a delightful snack or side dish.

ingredients.name: Beans
ingredients.notes: Broad beans, canned or cooked from scratch

instructions: Cook broad beans according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the cooked beans and zesty sauce, stir well.
Roll out empanada dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the bean mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the empanadas are golden brown.
Optional: Top with crispy breadcrumbs and shredded cheese before baking.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro before serving.
